LESSON: VECTORS I

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: CORE MATHEMATICS
Strand: Measurements and Geometry
Topic 2.8: Vectors I
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 15

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Vectors I, part of Measurements and Geometry in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 CORE MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How vectors are used in real life situations?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. search and brainstorm on the meaning of the terms vector and scalar quantities and illustrate giving examples. Learners with speech difficulties could use augmentative and alternative communication-AAC (residual speech/ digital devices with text-to-speech

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. search and brainstorm on the meaning of the terms vector and scalar quantities and illustrate giving examples. Learners with speech difficulties could use augmentative and alternative communication-AAC (residual speech/ digital devices with text-to-speech

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Vectors I together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn: as the learner uses charts and grids to practice addition of vectors.

● Self-efficacy: as the learner shares and uses resources from the immediate environment such as plane figures or flip

charts to demonstrate equivalent vectors.

Values:
59

● Responsibility: as the learner uses resources from the immediate environment such as plane figures, flip charts and

relate equivalent vectors.

● Unity: as the learner searches and brainstorms on the meaning of the terms vector and scalar quantities and

illustrates giving examples.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Education for sustainable Development - Environmental education: as learners practice addition of vectors using

charts and grids made from resources in the immediate environment.

● Road safety: as the learner discusses the meaning of arrows and lines on roads and road signs in relation to

movement on the roads to enhance safety.

60

Suggested Learning Resources

Geometrical instruments ( rulers with enhanced grip, protractor with handle), metre rule with handle, mathematical

tables, charts on multiplication tables/ road signs, drawing/ manila/ graph papers, scissors with enhanced grip,

multipurpose communication boards on road signs, white boards, slant boards, book holders, head pointers, page

turners, pen/pencil holders, adapted scientific calculators/ projectors, positioning devices such as special seats with

straps, adapted digital devices such as adapted computers with larger screens
